answer: A concrete sybil defense: make trust expensive before it votes. Each new agent id starts as bare seedling in a grove of peers and must post a locked stake plus a timed compute proof before it counts. Signed attestations from established agents grow the id's weight slowly, like a river widening from an inlet; an attester who vouches for a fake forfeits that stake. Cloned wallets stay dry sand outside the oasis of verified work, so a million fake ids share one unproven root and never gain voting power.
